main_body: A bonsai-style pine tree: a twisted brown trunk topped by three layered green foliage pads (cloud canopy).
top_band: Foliage pads: lighter green (#4e8355/#3a6c44) rows near the top of each pad, with darker green underneath; organic canopy, no flat rectangular top. Column x=22 rows 1-8 light greens, rows 9-13 darker underside.
evidence: Organic tree. The canopy pads read as rounded masses with lighter upper surfaces and darker undersides (rows 9-13 at x=22), and the trunk runs below with a visible gap. The 3/4 contract is not a strict match for organic shapes, and the canopy lighting reads acceptably as volume. The kind is organic, so the rigid top/front rules apply loosely.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 11 distinct colours and a median of 8 per tile, against 108-109 and 427-567 for the references, so it is far less rich. The canopy has about 4 greens (#4e8355, #3a6c44, #2b5636, #172f1f) with some dithered clumping, and the trunk has about 3 browns. The outline is partly neutral: 37% of dark edge pixels are near-neutral, with near-black #0f1e16 on the foliage and #231d28 around the trunk, which is a greyish purple-black rather than a brown tint. The references are far denser and use tinted outlines throughout. The 5x5 flat-fill coverage is 0%, which is good, but the shading and colour variety are clearly thinner than Beodeul.
